Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) The review/autofix pipeline (`.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` and its `scripts/review_autofix_step_*.sh` helpers)
B) The orchestrator (orchestrate / orchestrate_poll workflows, `scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh`, `scripts/orchestrate_lib.py`)
C) The clarify / plan / implement phases (workflows and `prompts/mode-*.txt`)
D) The AI memory subsystem (`scripts/ai_memory.py`, `scripts/memory_helpers.sh`, `ai-memory` schemas)
E) Docs only (README.md, `docs/how-it-works.md`, agents.d fragments)
F) Something else: I'll name the file, workflow or feature in my answer (RECOMMENDED)
Q2: What concrete problem or result should "better" mean?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure: I'll link the failing run, PR or log line (RECOMMENDED)
B) Cut cost or runtime (tokens, GitHub API calls, CI minutes): I'll give the metric and target
C) Make it more reliable (fewer stalls, retries or flaky runs): I'll give the incident or symptom
D) Make it easier to use or understand (docs, log messages, operator surfaces): I'll describe what's confusing
E) A new feature or behaviour: I'll describe the expected behaviour
Q3: How will we know the change worked?
Choices:
A) A named test or contract test passes, or a named failure stops happening (RECOMMENDED)
B) A measured metric moves past a stated threshold (I'll give it)
C) A reviewer checks it by hand against a description I provide
